basis: Existing read-only SQLite snapshot, invocation configurations, public event stream and local fixture bytes. No rerun, no artifact or rubric changes.
excluded: Lease/claim tokens and private reasoning are excluded. User home prefix normalized in metadata; local fixture and prompt bytes unchanged. Native source manifests are host-reported observations, accompanied by the previously archived actual HTTP/MCP reads. Reported method application is not proof of quality.
sourceChangeLimit: The third prompt explicitly asks for corrected-record reanalysis. This pair does not establish autonomous change detection or interrupted-work recovery. Separate deterministic stale-evidence and recovery trials cover bounded mechanisms.
freshnessLimit: Synthetic fixtures disclose authority, supersession and unit warnings. Unfamiliar-domain/schema inference requires additional held-out trials.
denominator: Preserve all six trials: 2 of 12 managed requests complete, 9 do not complete and 1 has an unreceipted interruption. Six Q&A trials pass.
